page_title: WER 0-2 HOF | Werder Bremen v Hoffenheim 27/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' The referee Frank Willenborg awards Bernardo (Hoffenheim) a yellow card.
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
90+6' The referee signals a substitution. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Prass.

90+6' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Frank Willenborg rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim).
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
90+4' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Werder Bremen will take a corner kick.
90+2' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90+2' 3:7 – the corner kicks stats.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
89' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
87' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
85' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
85' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
82' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
76' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Julian Malatini will be replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Cameron Puertas can be given a rest.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tim Lemperle walks off the pitch to be replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
75' The attendance is 39500.
75' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
75' Frank Willenborg interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen). It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
73' Booking. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) receives a caution from the referee.
70' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
69' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.
69' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
65' Celebrations are cut short for Werder Bremen as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
65' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Werder Bremen players aren’t happy.
64' Goal! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) latches onto the ball inside the box and scores a fantastic back-heel goal. He makes it 1:2.
63' The free kick is taken by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim), but ball is cleared.
62' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
62' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Hoffenheim.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) coming on for Justin Njinmah.
59' Horst Steffen has decided to substitute Olivier Deman and he is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen).
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is replacing Andrej Kramaric.
59' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

58' Oliver Baumann is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen), pushing the ball around the post to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
56' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Hoffenheim players have a reason to celebrate!
55' Wait! Referee Frank Willenborg has indicated he is going to review the Hoffenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
54' 0 - 2 Goal! Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 0:2.
52' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Frank Willenborg produces a RED card from his pocket and Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) heads for an early shower!

51' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim), but referee Frank Willenborg must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
50' This is a yellow card! Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
48' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
47' Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
47' Frank Willenborg has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen).
46' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top right corner.
44' Frank Willenborg blows the whistle, Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul.
43' A cross from a corner kick by Hoffenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
38' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
38' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
37' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle and signals a foul after Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) brought his opponent down. Werder Bremen have a free kick from a promising distance.
36' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Frank Willenborg stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
34' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
32' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The corner from Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is hurriedly cleared.
26' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.

19' Werder Bremen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
17' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
16' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Soren Storks no option but to blow his whistle.
14' Hoffenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
13' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) is able to continue to play.
11' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Werder Bremen, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
10' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
9' Hoffenheim fail to score from a corner as Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen) leaps to collect the ball.
8' The corner from Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Mio Backhaus.
8' The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
4' The ball is behind the sideline. Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) takes a throw-in.
2' None of the Hoffenheim players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
1' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Frank Willenborg is the one to supervise the game today.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
